commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

id.description: An owned instruction's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

sessionId.description: The minted session whose scratch workspace holds the file.

path.description: The Markdown file: relative to the session's scratch workspace, or an absolute path inside it; a .md file.

catalogueId.description: The catalogue entry the instruction was tailored from, its origin.
